definitions.short: Ramoth-Negeb or Ramath-Negeb , a place in Palestine
definitions.usage: south Ramoth, Ramath of the south.
definitions.full: H7418. Ramoth -negeb רָ(א)מַת proper name, of a location construct, in combination: 1 לֶחִ֑י רָמַת Judg 15:17 , see II. לְחִי p.534. 2 הַמִּצְמֶּה רָמַת Josh 13:26 (P), in Gilead, on northern border of Gad; Αραβωθ [A Ραμωθ ᵐ5 L Ραμεθ ] κατὰ Τὴν Μας ( ση ) φα ; = II. מִצְמֶּה 3 ; on (dubious) identification compare GASm Geogr. 586 f. Buhl Geogr. 262. 3 נְ֫גֶב רָאמַת Josh 19:8 (P), Βαμεθ [A ᵐ5 L Ιαμεθ ] Καρὰ λίβα (= בַּעֲלַתבְּֿאֵר 19:8 , q. v. p. 128); probably = רָמוֺתנֶֿ֫גֶב 1Sam 30:27 , Ραμα νότου ; site dubious, see Dr Hast. DB. RAMAH .
definitions.rootNote: or רָמַת נֶגֶב ; from the plural or construct form of 7413 and 5045 ; heights (or height) of the South;
